name: midgard_01
text: For the third winter... no summer comes.
instruct: A mature male narrator with a deep, resonant bass-baritone voice, a weathered grain and a clear British English accent. An ancient storyteller proclaiming a Norse saga. Solemn authority, dark grandeur, emotionally committed theatrical delivery. Deliberate phrasing with meaningful silence. Keep the same vocal identity throughout. Clear consonants and natural breaths. Begin with grave, hushed weight, then let the dread gather. Full chest resonance, not whispering.

name: midgard_04
text: Hrym marches across the frozen sea. Drive his army back... before the endless night.
